# mergeah_tool_pack_tool_description_override (Resource)

Manage one Tool Pack tool description override; destroy restores inheritance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_tool_pack_tool_description_override" "example" {
  tool_pack_id   = "a6d21b9d-6235-4f85-b175-0799fc4bfed1"
  connector_slug = "linear"
  tool_name      = "list_issues"
  description    = "Tools for the support agent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connector_slug` (String) Merge API field `connector_slug`. Changes require replacement.
- `description` (String) Merge API field `description`.
- `tool_name` (String) Merge API field `tool_name`. Changes require replacement.
- `tool_pack_id` (String) Merge API field `tool_pack_id`. Changes require replacement.

### Read-Only

- `defined_at` (String) Value reported by Merge: `defined_at`.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_tool_pack_tool_description_override.example 'a6d21b9d-6235-4f85-b175-0799fc4bfed1/linear/list_issues'
```
